name: io.github.icnocop/atlassian-mcp-server
title: Atlassian MCP Server
description: Unofficial MCP server for Jira Cloud and Confluence Cloud, with Confluence private drafts.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASSIAN_SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Atlassian Cloud site URL, such as https://example.atlassian.net.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASSIAN_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email address of your Atlassian account.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An API token for your Atlassian account.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASSIAN_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated toolsets to enable. Defaults to all.
